exposure: Gestational age at birth (37 weeks, 38 weeks, ≥ 39 weeks)

cohort: 43 healthy term newborns born by programmed cesarean section
finding: During the first 48 hours of life, blood pressure and systemic vascular resistance gradually increase, while stroke volume, cardiac output, and cardiac index decrease, with variations observed based on gestational age at birth, birth weight, and presence of patent ductus arteriosus.
